The thread's collective appetite for reassurance has palpably diminished since the last propulsion incident, and several contributors now insist that revised venting protocols, subjected to independent scrutiny rather than internal review, ought to precede any subsequent flight. Prospective Starlink subscribers, contemplating the risks with characteristic prudence, have elected to defer their subscriptions until the engineering case becomes marginally more persuasive.
